title: Music Assistant shared icons manifest
description: The icon-set contract: the list of canonical icon ids plus the fallback. Everything else (display names, categories, keywords, artwork provenance) is non-normative metadata in meta.json and is deliberately kept out of this schema.

version.description: Semantic version of the icon set.

fallback.description: Icon id clients must render when they encounter an unknown id.

icons.description: Every canonical icon id. Ids are stable forever: never renamed, never removed.
